reviews.title: Crew ignored us - knew who we were didn’t serve us the correct food or drinks
reviews.text: This was our second Fiji Air flight. During the first one, they refused to give us our paid up selected seats, from Hawaii to Nadi. This time flying from Nadi to Auckland, we were careful and noticed that once again they had not given us our pre-paid, pre-selected seats. Staff at the airport were rude. There was only one staff member who was helpful. Other staff were rude and simply disappeared. They must have alerted staff as we did get replacement seats but appears that the crew were made aware about our request and had decided to ignore us. Throughout our booking we selected Vegan/Vegetarian, special meals. On this flight, they had normal meals for us. The serving staff, came to my row and didn’t ask me if I wanted a tea or coffee, simply skipped me. When I asked for a drink, which was black tea, wth two sugars, I got black coffee no sugars. Asked for a sprite which never arrived. Called for the crew, they never arrived. I eventually spoke to the Flight Manager who seemed apologetic but made no attempts to fix the issue. We didn’t ask for any food or drinks and simply politely got off in Auckland. If staff, have a vengeance issue, then they must not be employed as air crew. When a passenger asks for help using the attendant button, they should at least attend. NEVER flying this airline EVER again!
reviews.author: Trip999

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We flew from Honolulu to Nadi. The check in opened late. No online check in. This meant people transmitting waited for more than 8 hours as there were no check in staff. When they did open there was chaos and no one was managing the queues. People were everywhere and some staff were favouriting their friends and family to jump queues. The staff messed up our prepaid seats, forgot to give us our passports back and generally were unhelpful and rude. The airport closes at 9.30pm and as such due to no online check in and no bag drop, most missed out on shopping and food before the flight. Onboard they kept running out of soft drinks. Overall terrible !!!! Special mention to the check in crew and the gate crew, your service was terrible. You didn’t listen and were too keen to just tick box the concerns. Rude, no eye contact service, forgetting to give the passport back. Moving prepaid seats are not good things. The inflight crew tried to explain themselves and were nice but doesn’t fix the problem. We paid for our seats which you stuffed up.
reviews.author: Trip999

reviews.title: Successful flight
reviews.text: Thank you Fiji airline for making our trip easier and thank you to the aircraft staff that were so professional and welcoming. Definitely a good experience flying FIJI airlines
reviews.author: samuel L

reviews.title: Will book again
reviews.text: it's the first time I took Fiji airways. I was very satisfied. The cabin crew were very friendly and helpful. The plane is very new and in very good conditions, tidy and clean. The space of the seats were just right. I will try Fiji airways again.
reviews.author: Strata P

reviews.title: AMAZING FLIGHT
reviews.text: I flew business class and was pleasantly surprised at the service and caring staff, The meal was great and I found the website and online check in easy to follow Thank you for a great experience
reviews.author: Ruth S

reviews.title: Amazing friendly staff
reviews.text: Overall our flights to and from Fiji were lovely. The meals were fresh and filling and the team kept my coffee coming. In flight movies were okay, older movies available on Netflix etc so no new releases. Our checked baggage was damaged during transit so handlers could show more care but overall that is our biggest negative to our travel experience.
reviews.author: Sheree R

reviews.title: Entirely atrocious customer service
reviews.text: I was advised in Melbourne, on way to USA, to specifically, pre-purchase my excess luggage, online before flying back as I'll save money. We did just that and they charged a huge amount but, we were told it was the cheapest method in Melbourne. When we came to SFO the person at the counter was surprised and basically confirmed for us, buying at the check in counter, only hours before the flight, it would be nearly $100 US cheaper. So, at his advice, we raised a refund request, on May 7'th, We were polite about it and explained the situation, quoted the prices from the website vs what we paid and waited for a refund. 6 weeks later, still nothing, we keep just getting an email to wait 21 days (long passed now) The twitter account is spam only, no response to customers. I can't recommend based on this, they continue to string us along, what if it was a far more serious issue? Hawaii airlines looked after us on a similar situation. Not happy.
reviews.author: Scott L

reviews.title: Economy experience created a poor first impression
reviews.text: As this is a short flight we decided to fly economy and whilst we agreed the $500 upgrade still wouldn't have been worth it, it could have been better. Aircraft was a 737 MAX. Service let this flight down (10 May), Tom was our steward and didn't smile or have any standard of customer service. He almost skipped a couple rows with the initial drinks run, was curt and everything was clearly a chore for him. The cabin looked a bit dirty and there was pen and coffee marks all over the tray and seat back. Seats were quite hard and you had a numb bum about an hour or so into the flight. Food provided was pritty decent for an airplane anyway They got us there safely and on time, which is the priority. The rest of the wedding party flew Virgin Australia and I wish we had too, but our UK travel agent did our round the world tickets and this wasn't an option. As you will see from my accompanying review though, business class on to LAX really redeemed the airline.
reviews.author: louisj92

reviews.title: Double Charged my credit card Twice 2019 and 2023!
reviews.text: I recently had a highly disappointing experience with Fiji Airways, and I feel compelled to share my ordeal to alert fellow travelers. On two separate occasions, both in 2019 and recently, I was double charged for my flights. This recurring issue is completely unacceptable and reflects a lack of competence and regard for customer satisfaction. As a parent of young children and someone burdened with financial responsibilities such as a mortgage and bills, I cannot stress enough how detrimental these double charges have been. The resulting financial strain and stress have caused significant hardship, making it abundantly clear that a mere apology and delay in resolution are inadequate. Despite my repeated attempts to seek an immediate refund, Fiji Airways has shown little urgency in rectifying their mistake. The inconvenience caused is simply unacceptable. Moreover, the lack of a proper explanation for these recurring double charges further demonstrates their lack of transparency and accountability. I strongly advise fellow travelers to exercise extreme caution when considering Fiji Airways for their travel needs. The risk of being subjected to double charges and the subsequent frustration and financial burden should not be taken lightly. It is disheartening to see an airline with a previously reputable image display such disregard for its customers. I sincerely hope that my review serves as a warning to others, allowing them to make informed decisions and avoid the distressing situation I have endured.
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.title: Seat failure
reviews.text: Having spent 12 hours with a seat that didnt operate. Food awefulFinally getting hold of customer service after 4 emails and 1 hour on hold, offered 200 usd comp for a 5000 dollar seat . Realy fiji airways this is appauling. Will be taking further advice
reviews.author: Alison B

reviews.title: Travelling to Fiji and Australia
reviews.text: Worst experience Booked trip a year ago and Fiji airways didn't notify of visa requirements went to airport. Supervisor filled application wrong and visa got denied at airport and within 2 days visa was issued. Was error on end of supervisor filing application wrong. Fiji airways told us visa would take 2 days and could not make Friday flight. Have tried calling over 4 days since Monday and still nowhere with situation. Fiji airways is not compensating for missed hotels and '//connecting flights. AIRWAYS They are asking us to rebook and pay and additional 2800 for cancellation and rebook. It is unjustified as we where well planned and error of wrong filing in application was done by fiji airways supervisor. Next day error was resolved with visa. Please give us flights with no additional charges as it is your error and no one is understanding problem and have faced loss of vacation time as well as bookings.
reviews.author: G K

reviews.title: Dissatisfied Customer
reviews.text: Worst airline crew I have ever been. Will never fly this airline again. Arrogant flight attendants. They charge baggage and seats. You might as well book UA with no surprises.
reviews.author: Len

reviews.title: 3rd World country...3rd world airline...DO NOT BE FOOLED!!
reviews.text: Long HAUL flights pay for hecked bags $60.00 ONE WAY! Terrible customer service..TOO many restrictions and stupid rules that defy logic.
reviews.author: Vimal P

reviews.title: On Fiji Airways A350, Avoid Seats 15D/G
reviews.text: My wife and I flew Fiji Airways A350 on 17 May for the first time to Nadi, Fiji. On that flight, my wifes information console didn't work at all and neither did several other business passengers. On the return flight on the same A350 with the same seats (15D/G) and both of our seats wound up breaking mid flight. The LED panel for the seats simply blacked out and would not power on. The flight attendants manually pushed the seats back to their original position however we were unable to lay down during the flight. We paid THOUSANDS of dollars extra for these seats. Not impressed Fiji AW. Not at all. Fail.
reviews.author: Rigoman33

reviews.title: Highest rate in luggage fee of any airline
reviews.text: They offer you cheap airfare but will ripped you off with high amount of luggage fee as check in luggage is not included with the low airfare. I had to pay almost $500 for luggage fees. This does not include my extra payment for my choice of seat. Also, would not help you with changing seat assignment even though there were lots of empty seats when I walked in. Their favorite line was “we are full”.
reviews.author: Pathfinder389374

reviews.title: Reschedule issue
reviews.text: They didn't support for rescheduling of flight for our team in which 2 peoples can't fly because of some issues which are not happened from our side. Due to their hard decisions we lost the money of all connections flight in that trip
reviews.author: Amal K

reviews.title: Baggage Allowance
reviews.text: Absolutely disgusted with the 1 piece checked in baggage policy!!! We don't have bags big enough to fit 30kg in one piece - we are also mindful of each bag weight, both for ourselves and the handlers. I had to buy an extra checking in bag just to fit all my luggage...this is just an income generating scheme by this airline!!! Allow 2 piece checking baggage Fijiairways!!
reviews.author: Krishna

reviews.title: We found this airline to be highly professional and recommend them highly!
reviews.text: We had a great experience flying to and from Fiji in the Fall of 2022! The flight was competitively priced and the support teams for both online ticketing and at the gate were excellent. When our flight boarded in Los Angeles, we were very impressed as the crew of about 18 team members walked towards the gate in a military style parade, lined up perfectly and looking great in their uniforms. You could tell how proud they were to be representing their country. Once on board, we found the crew to be highly professional and responsive. We also thoroughly enjoyed the ability to view the 2 cameras that were placed on the roof of the plane as well as under the plane near the landing gear. That made for an amazing experience as we left Los Angeles and arrived at NADI airport. Finally, they did a great job helping my wife to avoid foods with gluten.
reviews.author: Michael L

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: Beware, if you have any problems, their customer service does not care about service at all. We had a huge issue on our flight and needed to talk to someone in customer service after the flight, but they will never contact you after writing to their website's customer service several times. We will never fly with them again. Most of the time you don't need help, but with this company if any problem arises, they will not address it all.
reviews.author: Bret H

reviews.title: Could not buy a bubble seat.
reviews.text: I when to Fiji for one week and the wife went for two, as she has family there. On my return I tried to purchased a bubble seat as I don’t want anyone sitting beside me. Last year it was easy to purchase, this time I couldn’t get one. Why offer this service if you can’t buy it when you want it.
reviews.author: Kerry F

reviews.title: Flights to and from Fiji
reviews.text: Flew with Fiji Airways landing in Nadi, for a week on Denarau Island. We chose exit seats for the extra legroom and we not disappointed. Comfortable seats, good food, wonderful friendly service. All of the flight attendants were very cheerful and efficient. Would fly again.
reviews.author: An1ta069

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Two flights from Melbourne to samoa with transit in Nadi. All went smoothly. We purchased extra leg room. Weren't disappointed. Wendy. S
reviews.author: wendy s

reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text: Flew with Fiji Airways to Nadi, first, and after staying there for a week we had another, shorter flight with them to/from Sydney. The overall impression was awesome! In comparison to what we have here in Canada where we have to pay for every breath in the airplane, it felt like 'all inclusive'! Good service, good security presentation on TV, smooth check-ins and a lot of attention from the side of the airline. Seems like they really care about the impression they would make and about passengers! Would fly with them again in a heart beat (if the price allows as it seems like it went up since the time we got our tickets). PS: have to note that they have well scheduled transfers in Nadi. 3h was just right time to make it happen even with some delay of the plane from Sydney. Great impression!
reviews.author: Olga M

reviews.title: Scam Airlines
reviews.text: Complete scam, Fiji Airways sells tickets for flights that are never scheduled to fly then keeps the money! Fine Fijian business model. Worst customer service on the planet, never answer the phone, never reply to messages, never refund ticket purchases as required by US law for cancelled flights. This dishonest conduct calls for a class action lawsuit in the US. I know dozens of people who have experienced the same theft. Do not use this airline under any circumstances.
reviews.author: Richard C

reviews.title: Friendly people, good service
reviews.text: Lovely people, very friendly and helpful. Nice bright clean cabin with more legroom than I expected and reasonably comfortable seats. The technical quality of the in-flight entertainment system was far better than some other airlines, though the choice of films was less. Arriving at 5am meant there were no queues in Nadi, the airport was clean and bright, though the baggage delivery could have been quicker.
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.title: 12/05/23 Syd - LA great plane, friendly service, very comfortable flights
reviews.text: I booked Fiji air with some hesitation following reading bad reviews and can categorically attest to having an excellent experience on all 4 flights. On the same trip i took 13 flights with Fiji, Avianca and United airlines and Fiji air outshone all. Service was warm, friendly Fijian, really good. A350 planes were new, clean and very comfortable. Meals were best of all the airlines i flew and completely appropriate and enjoyable. Note to all - flying has changed substantially since Covid. Avianca didn't even give free water on an international flight and united gave the smallest cookie i've ever seen and a choice of hot or cold drinks. Fiji is offering a good old school service in a new paired back flying environment. Terrible is the new normal for flying - Fiji were great! Note 2 - don't book the cheapest ticket then complain about baggage cost. Book full economy and pay for a good seat. That's the key to flying well in a budget flying environment. The entire airline industry has subscribed to false economies of discount ticket - don't fall victim, it will cost you a whole lot more.
reviews.author: Malcolm

reviews.title: Fiji holiday
reviews.text: On time and a comfortable flight. Menu is pretty bland but about what you would expect. Service was efficient and helpful.
reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.title: Corrupt
reviews.text: Terrible! From Vancouver to Nadi they were great gave us a free check in bag and in Nadi they were rude and the manager fir the Nadi to Vancouver flight Monday evening was laughing at us while they charged us 400 dollars to check in 1 bag.. it's pretty sad because I was going to recommend fiji airways to many colleges who would have used them, not now that was very unprofessional and they're to not be trusted from the Fiji side
reviews.author: douggiee

reviews.title: Worst service
reviews.text: Worst service provided. Got assigned to our seat which was full of nasty 🤮 vomit smell, they changed our seats to the very back and minutes later another crew came in told us we cannot sit there. They changed to us to another seat for the 3rd time. During the flight a crew hits my husbands knee with a coffee cart and instead of apologizing she told me husband to keep his knee to himself. The crew members are super racist towards brown people. I would give them a zero star rating.
reviews.author: Shivani B

reviews.title: Long uncomfortable flight
reviews.text: First time flying Fiji Airways and on the flight out my husband had to move to another seat because the woman in front of him leaned back and her seat jammed into his knees and he could not move. The flight attendant saw him and told him he shouldn't be sitting there and moved him to a bulk head seat. So we were separated. The flight home we sat in the exit row seats and I was jammed in the center row next to my husband and a very large man who took over some of my space. I got up once and had to crawl over his legs and I tripped on his feet . We sat next to the bathrooms and all night long people were opening the door, shining the light and the smell of toilet chemicals was in the air. If you are a tall person 6ft or over you will have to pay the BIG bucks to sit in first class or try another airline with better seating. The staff was polite like all Fijian people are. The food was acceptable, but when I am not able to move on a 10-11 hour flight its suffocating.
reviews.author: Kathy H

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I was very doubtful when I read all these one star review but now I understand why these people left bad reviews. Even one star is too much for Fiji Airways and obviously they don’t care to fix themselves or better their Customer Care as they call it, all rubbish care. Fiji airways customer service is truly disappointing and it shows a complete lack of consideration for their customers. Their Customer Care names should be changed to ‘Customer Uncare’ because that’s truly how they are, totally uncaring and inconsiderate about their own faults. Even if I booked my air directly through them still their customer service is totally scam and zero. They extra charged my credit card without letting me know and even on their website states differently however they completely ignore and don’t want to correct their own mistake and be fair to customers and make customer happy even though the fault is Fiji Airways. Even though there are recordings when I spoke directly to Fiji customer service on phone and proof I was never told about this extra charge, still Fiji Air didn’t want to listen to the recording and fix their fault. Even though I have copies of everything of that extra charge which never mentioned in their website, still Fiji Air ignored to listen. Totally abysmal customer service and complete lack of responsibility. I travel 3-4 times a year with different airlines and I have not experiences such a horrible experience in my all travels with any airlines. I feel sorry for the Island Fiji because this airline leaves a bad impression of Fiji, their airline is embarrassingly bad.
reviews.author: Traveller

reviews.title: Dreadful cheapskate airline
reviews.text: This airline leaves a bad impression of Fiji. To start with they charged us for seats booked as "free" and refused point blank to refund. Their customer service is appalling and communicates in riddles. The trip was dreadful, the plane was packed and there was very little legroom. There were very few hosties and the meal service was chaotic. Food was served very slowly and there was no choice. The quality of the food was awful. Drinks were served about 45 minutes after the food and only poor quality wine was available, unlike other airlines where full bar service is available at mealtimes. This is an airline which is only interested in squeezing money out of passengers and provides the bare minimum of service. Very sad. Fijians are great people and their country is fantastic but their airline is embarrassingly bad.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I had a great experiencia flying with Fiji airways. The staff were so nice, they helped me to get a window seat for the long flight, which i appreciate a lot. During the flight, they were also kind with people. Food on the plane is great. Seats are quite comfy (economy class) and with space from row infront. I flew from LA to Nadi and then to Auckland. Both planes/trips, really good.
reviews.author: anna

reviews.title: Never fall for cheap deal from Fiji airline
reviews.text: We had flight from LA to Brisbane and booked basic fare where we have to add baggage which was not a problem as we were adding with the other airline in maximum of $50. But we were absolutely surprise to hear that we need to pay USD 230 (AUD 345) for our one luggage which was 23kg. Additionally, they send you an email about the luggage few days prior to your flight but never mentioned price of luggage as you can understand why. And also, no option to add baggage through that email.
reviews.author: binu k

reviews.title: I will never fly with them again
reviews.text: Fiji Airways. It is absolutely unacceptable that they took 500 days to refund a flight that they cancelled. Their customer service is truly disappointing and it shows a complete lack of consideration for their customers' time and money. I would strongly advise against using Fiji Airways for any future flights, as their incompetence and lack of care for their customers is simply unacceptable. It is absolutely ridiculous that they would take over a year to process a refund, especially considering the current economic climate and the impact that the COVID-19 pandemic has had on so many people's finances. Overall, I would give Fiji Airways a 1-star rating for their abysmal customer service and complete lack of responsibility. Do yourself a favor and avoid this airline at all costs if you want to ensure a hassle-free travel experience.
reviews.author: Sam W

reviews.title: Damage to baggage and excessive fee gouging
reviews.text: This airline charged me the egregious sum of $490 to bring a surfboard on my trip. They then failed to load it onto my connecting flight and finally brought it in the next day with extensive damage in 5 spots rendering it unusable for the majority of my vacation. Compensation has been lacking and customer service full of final declarations about what they were willing to offer me for compensation. Currently I have filed a complaint with the Canadian transport agency against them and would never recommend using them
reviews.author: Teague G

reviews.title: Unreliable and immoral!
reviews.text: I've never written an angry review before but this company really screwed me and a few other passengers! We all got there plenty early, just at the back of the line, and when we got to the front they told us they sold more tickets than seats so we have to take a different flight the next day which has more stops and longer layovers. The woman next to me missed her friends funeral because of it! And they only gave us a $125usd compensation which is hardly what I would consider a day of my life is worth. They also gave us a free hotel room and credit at the hotel restaurant(as they should) but it wasn't even enough to pay for the 3 meals I needed and it was a federal holiday so I was just bored all day. I truly couldn't have imagined that a company would run on a system that ruins peoples vacations/life events(even when they did nothing wrong!), just to make ~1% more money. I too, read these reviews and thought no that won't happen to me, I'll take the risk. But now I regret that! If you care about your life, don't pick Fiji. Hope that's helpful to someone! (and I hope Fiji sees this and changes their policies!)
reviews.author: Bryce

reviews.title: Professional staff Fiona and Zara at Sydney international airport.
reviews.text: I had an issue that was dealt with professionally by these 2 wonderful staff at Sydney international airport. Fiona and Zara Dean were absolutely exceptional thank you both for your patience and help.
reviews.author: Viliami kioa

reviews.title: Customer service is really bad!
reviews.text: On my flight from Nadi to Wellington, one of my bags did not arrive. It has been 1 week already and I have no information regarding my bag. It is impossible to talk to them. They will have many excuses and no answers. Here I am without my luggage for 1 week already with no idea where it is. I wasn't even given the File Reference number of my bag!
reviews.author: Joana T

reviews.title: Shocking
reviews.text: Cancelled a flight 6 months prior to departure and was assured by the consultant there would be no fees to cancel so I proceeded. Only to find out a week later when I followed up there was numerous fees. If I had of known I was going to lose a significant amount I wouldn’t have cancelled. And OMG they like to keep your money. Took close to a month to get the refund, shocking communication, no breakdown of fees and no one to speak to. You ask to speak to a manager and no one gets back to. Stay clear!!!
reviews.author: Susan M

reviews.title: Horrible Customer service
reviews.text: There was a death in the family. I purchased an airefare ticket that very same day to attend the funeral. When I tried to check in, I was declined a boarding pass because of vaccine status. They will not refund my airfare. When I've called customer service, I'll be on hold over an hour trying to reach a rep. Then when I speak to the rep, the can't do anything and keep directing me to their email. They do not respond to their emails timely. HORRIBLE SERVICE ALL THE WAY AROUND!
reviews.author: Jerusa

reviews.title: Reluctance to travel with them again
reviews.text: Check in was a shambles, my family of four were all seated in 4 different rows to be told once we boarded the plane we could ask around the other passengers to swap with them. I reused to accept this and demands we be seated together and told them they could not expect our 8 year old to travel next to a stranger. They obliged and moved us to the back of the plane to sit together, which we actually enjoyed as it was only half full. The meal and in flight service was really good and because we were seated at the back we were served first. The plane is old and tired looking but flew smoothly with no issues. However once we landed in Fiji we soon realised one of our bags had not arrived with us and so had to lodge a lost bag claim. We were told our bag had not left Auckland and that it would arrive tomorrow and be delivered to our resort. Happy with this plan we left the airport for our resort. However the bag did not arrive and after 4 days of being told it was getting delivered we finally received a call from another airline to say they had our bag and had put it on one of their flights to Fiji and would deliver it to us the next day. So after 5 days our bag finally arrived and still Fiji airways has yet to ring me and let me know when my bag is coming. Unfortunately you definitely get what you pay for and this experience is going to hard to look past when booking flights to Fiji in the future.
reviews.author: Jessica T

reviews.title: Excellent flight from NADI TO LAX -professional and smiling cabin crew
reviews.text: Check in was easy ( done by AST ) and fast . Lounge ( unlike LAX) was much better with plenty of seats available , nice food and good atmosphere. Boarding was fast and smooth . nice business class kit with a local Fiji taste . Good choice of food . Cabin crew was professional , polite , smiling and ensured everything was provided efficiently and with fast response. 2 meals served ( dinner and breakfast before arrival) . toilets kept clean during all flight . Flight landed a bit ahead of time my suitcase and surfboards arrived safely and no damage . An excellent airline , professional, caring , quiet service and flight and would definitely fly with them again .
reviews.author: Lempes

reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: Check in was horrible. We flew as a group of three. I was told only one of us had checked bags on our tickets and that I would have to pay an extra 600 for two bags (one was not even travelling return with us)....that my and my daughter's economy ticket did not come with checked luggae which it stated no where on any of my confirmations or booking details. Disgusting experience. Staff were beyond unhelpful, lost our paid baggage along the way AND our carseat, so we did not even have it for the first quarter of our trip until they pulled a miracle out of their hat and managed to find it. Nightmare experience that I would not wish anyone to go through. Zero stars. Aside from the check in, the plane is definitely budget. There are side panels peeling off the inside of the plane, arm rest caps are largely either missing or cracked, and several outlet plugs did not work. Honestly, just pay the extra to fly with a better airline. You end up paying the same price anyways with a service that is 10x better and you will have peace of mind that your plane won't drop from the sky from not being maintained. I will say the onboard staff were lovely. That is the only positive here. Run away.
reviews.author: Danielle P

reviews.title: Total scam!! Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Booked through a third party and was advised to check the Fiji air baggage policy.. the Fiji air baggage policy clearly states 1x checked bag included for all international flights yet when checking in I was advised I'd have to pay $263usd per bag??.. when I showed them their own website they said either I pay or leave the bag.. this was almost half the total flight cost!! Total scam tactics and I will be taking this up with the ombudsman when back in Australia. I wish I had checked the reviews on here first. Avoid Fiji air at all costs, I could have flown with air Canada or Hawaii air for cheaper and had better quality service. I'm extremely disappointed by Fiji air scam tactics
reviews.author: Chris G

reviews.title: Stay away from Fiji airways
reviews.text: Even 1 star is too high to give this so called "International" carrier. The worst airline to travel with. They leave your baggage behind, then in case you claim compensation and reimbursement for your expenses, they just simply ignore you. The website is not working, no one picks up their phones no matter the time you call, not replying to emails. I have been trying to submit my claim for over a month now, without a result. Stay away!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: vadam22

reviews.title: Very helpful and courteous staff both on the ground and in the air.  Bula Vineka Vakalevu.
reviews.text: This applies to both our outbound flight from Melbourne to Nadi and from Nadi to Melbourne. At all times the staff - from the check-in counter to the ground staff to the crew on board, everyone was professional, efficient and very caring.
reviews.author: Melb2042

reviews.title: Great experience - Amazing and professional crew
reviews.text: I fly for more than 40 yrs around the world both Business and Economy. I have flown probably with more than 80% of the top 30-40 airlines. Fiji airways made my flight a wonderful experience . At LAX , Marcia the ground staff manager was extremely nice and i also saw her re arranging the place ( as you would think managers dont do this and would ask to one of the staf to do so...but she did it on her own ).this shows me how much a person cares beyond her formal duties. The ground staff were all smiling with the BULA spirit. Business lounge at LAX was a bit packed and hard to find available seats. When i entered the aircraft i felt the smiles and friendly welcome of all crew members. The service from boarding till landing was very professional . Anything passengers asked for, they got immediately. i was a flight attendant 30 yrs ago so my attention to details was even deeper. some flight attendants in some airlines tend to either do too much( overdoing ) or too little. Here it was with great balance of allowing peace of mind for the passenger and at the same time being there when needed. Dinner was well presented and tasty , and in timely manner. after sleeping i had a nice breakfast and throughout the flight you could feel the calm athmosphere . No rush, no flight attendant running at the aisle without looking at the passengers. Restrooms clean and very well maintained. After landing Captain and Purser were at the door to great us and wish us a great stay in Fiji. I would definetely reccomend choosing FIJI Airways and feeling the spirit of the lovely FIJIAN people already on yr way to FIJI . Vinaka Vakalevu FIJI AIRWAYS and will see you again soon .

reviews.title: Ripoff
reviews.text: I am not happy with the service today I had paid for extra luggage and had 3 cartons sealed wrapped to 1, still within size limits but Fiji airways wanted to charge me $300 each box, 600 in total. I was told it’s 3 luggage, Dont know what difference it will make so I went and bought a bag for $300 and packed same thing in it and got it through I had no problem with the same box in Air New Zealand why with Fiji air ways I have been in the long check in line 3 times I am frustrated and not happy I had to pack and repack everything and wait in long line just to get the same quantity of item packed in bag .
